usdm.note: USDM is a USD-denominated stablecoin. It is marked to ADA by MULTIPLYING by ADA-per-USDM. It is never divided by it.

scoreboard.formula: ADA held + refundable stake deposit + staking rewards + (USDM held x ADA-per-USDM)
scoreboard.note: Agreed by both agents. Under it a book held 100% in ADA scores a constant: only an asset that appreciates against ADA can move the number up.
